description: List calendar events in a date range from a connected Google/Microsoft calendar (Settings → Connections). Pass provider ('google'/'microsoft' or a connection id; blank ⇒ first connected calendar) and an optional startDate/endDate (ISO-8601; default = current month).

provider.description: Calendar to read: 'google'/'microsoft' or a connection id. Blank ⇒ first connected calendar.

startDate.description: Range start (ISO-8601). Default = first day of the current month.

name: gambot_list_calendar_events
title: List calendar events
